instruction: Push local master to origin/master (McFrenchPants/spotify-jukebox) so I can pull it elsewhere and test the recently-merged lyrics feature, while the orchestrator keeps working on the unrelated, unmerged sdlc-supervisor branch. Not a merge -- master already has the lyrics-integration merge commit (e1552ab). Confirm local tests pass first, use the approval-record mechanism as a real test of it, and report back the record and the new origin/master SHA.
notes: Preflight (all on local master, HEAD e1552ab): backend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; backend `npx vitest run` -> 45 test files / 387 tests passed; frontend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; frontend `npm run build` succeeded (tsc -b && vite build, dist output produced). config.yaml version 1.0.24 matches CHANGELOG.md's top entry (lyrics feature). Action taken: `git checkout master` (from feature/sdlc-supervisor, working tree was clean, no changes lost), `git rev-parse master` confirmed e1552ab3541edc2a5f0dacbfe7ae1ab22f0d4a75 matching this record's commit_sha, `git push origin master` -> `2a5adef..e1552ab master -> master` (clean fast-forward, no force needed), then `git fetch origin master` + `git rev-parse origin/master` confirmed origin/master now at e1552ab3541edc2a5f0dacbfe7ae1ab22f0d4a75, matching local master exactly. Infrastructure gap: the .sdlc/approvals/ mechanism and docs/sdlc/APPROVAL_RECORDS.md are tracked only on the unmerged feature/sdlc-supervisor branch, not on master. This record was written directly to disk (mkdir + Write) while master was checked out, rather than committed to either branch's history, so as not to (a) introduce unrelated sdlc-supervisor-framework files into master's history via this push, or (b) commit anything to feature/sdlc-supervisor, which the instruction explicitly said to leave untouched. It is therefore NOT part of git history on any branch as of this push -- a durable-but-untracked local file that will disappear if this working tree is `git clean`ed or another branch is checked out over it. Once the sdlc-supervisor framework is actually merged, this file should be reconciled (moved/re-created under proper git tracking) so the audit trail is preserved in history.
